newsitem.title: ZAMBIA: ZAMBIA STOCKS WEEK - VOLUMES RISE ON EXCHANGE.
newsitem.headline: ZAMBIA STOCKS WEEK - VOLUMES RISE ON EXCHANGE.

text.p: Traded volume rose on the Lusaka
Stock Exchange in the week ended January 24.
Exchange officials said volume rose to 753,105 shares valued
at 17,167,522 kwacha from 138,435 shares worth 2,137,989 kwacha
the previous week.
Zambia Sugar gained one kwacha to end the week at 12 kwacha
and saw 402,476 shares worth 4,777,212 kwacha exchanging hands.
Rothmans remained steady at 33 kwacha in a traded volume of
180,000 shares valued 5,940,000 kwacha.
Farmers House fell 20 kwacha to end the week at 180 kwacha
in a traded volume of 222 shares worth 39,960 kwacha while
Chilanga Cement, steady at 50 kwacha, saw 118,907 shares valued
at 6,045,350 kwacha.
Exchange officials predicted that the high activity of
Zambia Consolidated Copper Mines (ZCCM) in Paris, where it
closed at 3,760 kwacha on January 23, could give investors
increased confidence in Chilanga.
"Buying Chilanga shares may be a useful proxy since the
prospects of Chilanga and ZCCM are highly correlated," they
said.
ZCCM saw no trades on the Lusaka exchange in the week.
